visualCharacteristics.purpose: product cards with icon badge, offer, checklist and quote buttons

contentPattern.structure: one row per card (cells merged): leading icon image, optional tag paragraph, heading, offer/text, tick list or icon list (items starting with an icon), link/button paragraphs

usage.when: product promotions with a feature checklist and Get a quote / Find out more buttons

reuseGuidance: shadow for raised benefit cards, light / grey-light for offer cards, compare for cover-type comparison cards with an icon above the title.
